working_title: Is There a Periodic System of Human Language? A Data-Driven Test Across the World’s Languages
core_question: Does cross-linguistic structural diversity exhibit reproducible recurrent organization that is better modeled by a periodic geometry than by ordinary factor, hierarchical, graph, manifold, or null models?

tests: compression beyond column-wise marginal-preserving shuffle null
residual pairwise feature association beyond permutation null
stage0.claim_limit: Stage 0 tests prerequisites only; it cannot establish periodicity.

promotion_requires: explicit model-comparison plan with held-out evaluation
novelty check finds no existing equivalent periodic-vs-nonperiodic test
